_description: NHRATS Rules & Governance Import Format Template
_notes: source: identifies the origin of this import (e.g., 'manual', 'nhra-pdf-2026', 'legacy-system')
import_version: format version number for backward compatibility
Import ID is generated automatically during processing
UUIDs are generated automatically for each rule if not provided

metadata.description: Optional metadata about this import batch

rules.class_scope: All|Specific class codes or null for all
rules.title: Required: Brief, descriptive title
rules.body: Required: Full rule text. Supports basic formatting.
rules.change_summary: Description of changes in this version

rule_number.description: Unique identifier for the rule (e.g., GEN-1.1, SAF-2.3)
rule_number.validation: Must be unique within the import and not conflict with existing rules

class_scope.description: Comma-separated list of class codes this applies to, or null for all

effective_from.description: Date when this rule becomes effective

effective_to.description: Date when this rule expires, or null if ongoing

version_number.description: Version number, starting at 1 for new rules

change_summary.description: Description of what changed in this version

_validation_rules.date_order: effective_to must be null or later than effective_from
_validation_rules.unique_rule_numbers: All rule_numbers within the import must be unique
_validation_rules.non_empty_content: title and body must contain non-whitespace content
